answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 41323 Country: United States of America Title: Can we keep the name of girl as ‘Aleena Fatimah’? Please tell us the meaning of ‘Aleena’. Please suggest Question: Can we keep the name of girl as ‘Aleena Fatimah’? Please tell us the meaning of ‘Aleena’. Please suggest. Answer ID: 41323 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1443/919/L=1433) ‘Aleena’ is a meaningless word hence you should give only the name ‘Fatimah’ to your daughter. Do not add ‘Aleena’ before it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
